SELECT
  qgp_date,
  SUM(metric_value) AS biddableSpend_postpaid_plus_broadband
FROM prdrzranalytics.lab42.sdi_vw_dashboardPulseTms_gold_unified_long
WHERE data_source = 'BIDDABLE_SPEND_CHANNEL'
  AND channel_group = 'All Channels'
GROUP BY qgp_date
ORDER BY qgp_date DESC;
